notes.title: Why did we choose the setting of Russian folk tales?
notes.content:
Russian fairy tales are an invaluable cultural heritage of Russia. They help children develop imagination, emotional sphere and moral principles. They teach you to live in a world where good always wins over evil. And how to properly fight for this good.


[h3]The rich heritage of Russian fairy tales[/h3]

Most of the fairy tales are familiar to us, since childhood. When parents or grandmothers read them at night. There are hundreds of characters, plots and motives in these stories. Something has already gained popularity these days (like the cartoons of the Mill studio). But even more is not too well known. We decided to use this wealth to create a world where a child can learn more about their favorite characters and discover new living heroes.


[h3]Recognition among the target audience[/h3]

Our target audience is children aged 5 to 12 years. At this age, children are very likely already familiar with at least Snake Gorynych and Baba Yaga. This makes our game more attractive to them, as they can get to know their favorite characters in a new reading. We have also added more rare guests from Russian folklore: Brownie, Auka and Uncle Chernomor.


[h3]Opportunities for a variety of tasks and levels[/h3]

The world of Russian fairy tales provides a huge number of opportunities for a variety of tasks and levels in the game. As an example, we have swamps with toads and a hut, and a city with houses and a stormy life, coastal rocks and forests ... Native tasks for young players are built in everywhere, some are based on fairy tales, and some are a tribute to modernity.


[h3]The opportunity to draw attention to the cultural heritage of Russia[/h3]

Nowadays it is especially important to pay attention to our culture. It has a huge layer of unique and vibrant heritage. We've taken up folklore and fairy tales, with a touch of nostalgia for the bright quests of the noughties. But take a look at other things: rich nature and opportunities for tourism, exhibitions and museums, cities-monuments to epochs and much more!
